blocks.content: We will use object-oriented programming to create this game. Our game will have three classes:

items: Board - to handle the tic-tac-toe board and handle winning/draw logic
Player - to handle the name of players and symbols they are using
Game - to handle the game logic

blocks.content: We have learned a lot of things in this tutorial. We will use some of them to build our game.
